payload.text: ISSUE:0007's wiring passed on vc's verdict of 2026-11-13 (9cc5f93, 78cabdc and 802de63, dc's runs in two Desk slots) and shipped in 0.1.9. On gyges, hv's brew upgrade verified the signature and ccusage --version read ccusage 0.1.9 (brew, 2762bbf961ea). dc holds the issue open (dc's hold 10) until T10 passes on hv's Mac and on Linux with brew alone, as its Acceptance asks. The Mac run is hv's, in the checkout: bin/devbin use dev, use opt and use brew in turn, each followed by ccusage --version and bin/devbin doctor, the link resting at brew; vc relays it to dc. The Linux leg is dc's on hv's OK, in a heavy Desk slot: on kovacs, brew install ccusage from the tap (a source build that may pull brew's rust), then in a clone at v0.1.9, bin/devbin use brew, the version line, doctor and a listing of the keg's libexec. vc has put to hv whether it runs now, after the compact, or moves to a new issue. Acceptance 4 closes on vc's PASS at 802de63, with ST0003 named for the change in shared mode. When dc closes the issue, vc tells devbin-vc (devbin 0326 closes once pplr#0001 and cldr#0001 have closed too).
